archetypes.name: wrapper-contract
archetypes.rationale: Step 2 routing now depends on wrapper stdout and exit-code ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new Step 2 post-dispatch wrapper and SKILL.md routing contract together. Focus on whether PHANTOM_* and COMMIT_SHA are consumed before exit-code routing, and whether branch mismatch behavior remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-portability
archetypes.rationale: The new Bash wrapper must run under macOS Bash 3.2 and larch-run rehydration.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the wrapper for Bash 3.2 compatibility, strict-mode behavior, plugin-root rehydration, and non-fatal rev-parse handling. Check that failure paths do not suppress the phantom probe tail. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
